extends CanvasLayer

@onready var overlay: ColorRect = $Overlay


func _ready() -> void:
	layer = 100
	overlay.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	overlay.modulate.a = 0.0


func change_scene(target_path: String, duration: float = 0.4) -> void:
	overlay.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	
	var fade_out := create_tween()
	fade_out.tween_property(overlay, "modulate:a", 1.0, duration)
	await fade_out.finished
	
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file(target_path)
	
	var fade_in := create_tween()
	fade_in.tween_property(overlay, "modulate:a", 0.0, duration)
	await fade_in.finished
	
	overlay.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE

const SAVE_FILE_PATH: String = "user://savegame.json"

@onready var continue_button: Button = %ContinueButton
@onready var new_game_button: Button = %NewGameButton
@onready var quit_button: Button = %QuitButton


func _ready() -> void:
	var has_save: bool = FileAccess.file_exists(SAVE_FILE_PATH)
	continue_button.visible = has_save
	
	if has_save:
		continue_button.grab_focus.call_deferred()
	else:
		new_game_button.grab_focus.call_deferred()
	
	new_game_button.pressed.connect(_on_new_game_pressed)
	continue_button.pressed.connect(_on_continue_pressed)
	quit_button.pressed.connect(_on_quit_pressed)


func _on_new_game_pressed() -> void:
	SceneManager.change_scene("res://story/story_screen.tscn")


func _on_continue_pressed() -> void:
	SceneManager.change_scene("res://story/story_screen.tscn")


func _on_quit_pressed() -> void:
	get_tree().quit()
